events.credibility_reason: OEIS editor noted the PrimeGrid results were not double-checked and the search was suspended in 2017 for unreliable testing; no independent verification of the 2^64 completion found.

why: The statement is a single existence question over all composites. The Wieferich-prime searches (Dorais–Klyve, PrimeGrid) and the Pinch/Ribenboim pseudoprime tables are finite checks that only restrict where a composite solution could hide, so they are instances (F5); they also all predate the snapshot. Shevelev et al. concern overpseudoprimes, and Ordowski's A376473, Guedes–Machado, Jones and Laniewski each study a different congruence or question, so all are variants. Carella is a heuristic about primes, so it gets none. Guedes–Machado is dated by its 2023 journal version (the first public written argument, which the record says comes before the 2026 arXiv v1), so it falls before the snapshot. No AI system is credited in any event.
doubts: The record left AI leads open: it did not establish whether OEIS A298944 is among the 492 conjectures in AlphaProof Nexus or OEIS Open, though the 404 on formal-conjectures OEIS/298944.lean is weak evidence it is not. The Guedes–Machado 2023 journal date comes from a search summary only. Neither point changes any row.
